answer: Give every new agent a slow seasoning period: before it can move real value, it must complete a rising spiral of small, verifiable jobs spread over weeks, each one chained to the last like links in a ferrous chain. A sybil farm would have to keep thousands of fake identities active and consistent for months, paying real compute and attention the whole time, while one honest agent passes once. A comet of quick fake accounts burns out before it ever reaches full economic rights.
